mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (as measured by the current FEDFUNDS level being below the previous month's level) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase (both HOUST and RSAFS rising) is associated with positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market fuels wage growth and inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the previous month signals robust supply-side economic activity, supporting corporate production and earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months when INDPRO increases from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when HOUST < 1100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signal a restrictive monetary policy combined with high inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) is associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%), the persistent inflation erodes real purchasing power and increases the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.
